name: Proton Drive

instructions.step1: Enter your Proton Account username or email and password.
instructions.step2: If two-factor authentication (2FA) is enabled, enter your current 6-digit 2FA code or OTP secret key.
instructions.step3: Your encrypted drive will mount natively to ~/ProtonDrive.

disclosure: This is a third-party application not officially supported by Proton.

fields.label: Proton Account Email / Username
fields.helper: Your Proton account login username or email address

fields.label: 2FA Code / OTP Secret (Optional)
fields.helper: Current 6-digit TOTP code if 2FA is active, or your OTP secret

fields.label: Mailbox Password (Optional)
fields.placeholder: Only required for legacy two-password mode
